## Scope: Chat 03B2 (PRIVATE ALPHA PROTOTYPE, NOT DEPLOYED)

**Stacked Draft PR** based on `social-combat-chat03b1-d1-cas-20261017` ([PR #440](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/pull/440)). Contains only 03B2-owned files relative to parent. No changes to telemetry, active browser runtime, Stage7.15, NPC, economy, voting, or production secrets.

- `gameplay-server/src/worker.js` runs the **merged pure Chat 03A lifecycle+resolver** server-side. Trusted `Date.now()`, generated battle IDs, no client actorId/role or state accepted for commands, strict participant public views only.
- Admin-only bootstrap (separate `ADMIN_CONTROL_TOKEN`, NOT telemetry owner token) mints two random 256-bit **battle-scoped bearer capabilities**; only SHA-256 token digests stored in separate `0002_battle_capabilities.sql` table. Admin distributes capabilities privately. This is a private-alpha capability-auth design, **NOT permanent user account identity**.
- Genesis snapshot + `battle.created` + both capability records use D1 transactional `batch()` from parent PR #440.
- Participant `GET /v1/battles/:id` (reconnect on another device), `POST /v1/battles/:id/commit`; server authenticates capability and derives actorId, regenerates expectedVersion on CAS retries, provides idempotent command receipts and rejects changed same-command payloads.
- Trusted automatic `reveal` after both commits and scheduled retry/timeout handling; **no finalize/recognition/voting bypass**, pending Chat05 gate. Never expose internal snapshot or opponent selection before reveal.
- Dedicated `wrangler.api-local-test.jsonc` is local-only; tests exercise isolated workerd/D1 with synthetic admin secret. No remote Worker or real player data.

## Gates / limitations

- First prove exact-head CI tests and independent review. This PR is **Draft / NOT READY / NOT MERGEABLE** until parent #440 is reviewed and integrated.
- Privacy/retention/backup schedule, actual identity provider, abuse controls/rate limiting, CORS allowlist and production admin bootstrap/distribution procedure **not approved**. No Cloudflare-hosted Worker deployment, no Safari acceptance.
- Capability tokens are transferable bearer secrets; clients cannot be distinguished as permanent verified human accounts. No user account signup, token rotation/revocation, auditing or public PvP security claim.
- Mafia/V12 excluded; no recognizedOutcome/finalization without Chat05.

[Authority issue #439](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/issues/439).
## Exact-head local integration evidence (2026-10-21)

Current PR HEAD `8f6720b1f1f3ad55638dae53c527601455eb6826`, parent PR #440 HEAD `ed6c01d50b49a5afa02437dac096c2f9e0551836`. [Private API PR CI #39603310675](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39603310675) **SUCCESS**: two isolated local D1 migrations; admin bootstrap/token separation; forbidden actor spoof/Origin; hidden selection before reveal; duplicate-command replay and changed-body rejection; two concurrent participant commands; automatic reveal; Worker restart/reconnect/replay; **scheduled timeout/no-show once, repeated Cron no duplicate transition**. [Cascaded SQL CI #39603310854](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39603310854) SUCCESS; [AI Forensics #39603310683](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39603310683) SUCCESS.

Evidence class: `CHAT03B2_LOCAL_WORKER_D1_PASS`, **not Cloudflare-hosted authenticated Worker acceptance**. Original hosted SQL API evidence predates #440's new genesis trigger. Both PRs remain DRAFT and unmerged, no runtime/Safari or permanent identity acceptance.

## 2026-10-21 latest fixes: concurrent same-ID and streamed-body security

**Exact current HEAD** `5132c35fa59fe559b4df0f5f7ee4d869fa73c4c5`. Fixed a reproducible cross-player correctness/security risk: two independently generated participant-local `commandId` strings previously collided in the shared `(battle_id,command_id)` receipt table. The Worker now prefixes IDs with a server-derived `A:` / `B:` namespace before lifecycle execution and receipt lookup. A and B may submit exactly the same client ID simultaneously and both persist; retries for each replay their own receipt. Separate battle capabilities are not interchangeable. The request body parser now enforces the 8KiB limit **while streaming**, including requests without Content-Length, instead of buffering unbounded input or counting UTF-16 characters.

**Exact-HEAD PR checks SUCCESS:** [Private gameplay API #39608600769](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39608600769), [parent SQL #39608600868](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39608600868), [AI Forensics #39608601173](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39608601173). A real local workerd+D1 integration test covers both same-ID parallel commits, individual replay, cross-battle token isolation, streaming request rejection, hidden selections, automatic reveal, restart/reconnect and scheduled no-show timeout. **NOT remote deployed/authenticated Worker acceptance.**

Open: independent exact-HEAD review, Cloudflare-hosted retest of parent genesis trigger, dedicated staging D1/Worker with approved identity/retention/secrets/backup/abuse controls, user Safari acceptance. No deployment or merge authorized; branch still Draft.

## 2026-10-21 confirmed scheduling regression and repair

Local workerd/D1 regression with 101 non-due battles and a two-commit waiting-for-reveal battle reproduced starvation against previous scheduled query: [red #39615767647](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39615767647), actual `committed` vs expected `revealed`. Updated the Cron SQL to select actionable rows only (all `committed` battles plus `created`/`waiting` with elapsed deadline), prioritizing reveals before expiration. Same test PASS on new code: [green #39615940955](https://github.com/samuray-games/AsyncScene/actions/runs/39615940955), alongside security, command replay, restart and timeout regressions. Latest HEAD `68dd481f176a47c212d7e93c29ef79f947dd1ca1` includes documentation only after proven code; exact-head checks may still be pending. PR remains Draft/unmerged, not independently approved or remotely deployed.
